dimensions.assessment: Affects individuals enrolled in Medicare prescription drug plans under Part D who experience premium adjustments.
dimensions.evidence: result in an increase in premiums for individuals enrolled under a prescription drug plan under part D of title XVIII

dimensions.assessment: Stabilizes and mitigates potential increases in Medicare Part D prescription drug premiums for seniors.
dimensions.evidence: continue in effect the Part D Premium Stabilization Demonstration... for 2027, 2028, and 2029

dimensions.assessment: Involves federal demonstration project expenditures to stabilize Part D premiums, though no specific spending total is stated in the bill text.
dimensions.evidence: continue in effect the Part D Premium Stabilization Demonstration... conducted pursuant to section 402 of the Social Security Amendments of 1967

dimensions.assessment: Mandates the continuation of a specific administrative demonstration program under existing Medicare statutory authority.
dimensions.evidence: the Secretary shall continue in effect the Part D Premium Stabilization Demonstration

dimensions.assessment: Mandates the demonstration through 2029 and indefinitely past 2030 unless specific premium conditions for termination are met.
dimensions.evidence: for 2027, 2028, and 2029... for 2030 and each subsequent year

missing_information: Estimated federal cost of continuing the demonstration program.
importance_detail.rationale: Requires the Secretary of Health and Human Services to continue the Medicare Part D Premium Stabilization Demonstration from 2027 through 2029 in a manner substantially similar to 2026, and continue it for 2030 and beyond unless termination would not increase prescription drug plan premiums.
